leads.claim: Swedish intelligence dispatched a naval salvage team to a lake to recover an object observed by a witness.
leads.why: The document describes a specific recovery operation for a physical object, though it does not explicitly confirm the object was of UAP origin.
leads.government_response: USAFE officers visited the site while operations were underway.
leads.quote: Swedish intelligence was sufficiently confident in his observation that a naval salvage team was sent to the lake.

doc_verdict: The document describes a specific recovery operation for an unidentified object by Swedish authorities, but it does not confirm the nature of the material or provide evidence of U.S. government possession.
